name: Denis82cz Maintenance Exceptions for Elementor – Keep Selected Pages Accessible
author: denis82cz

sections.description:
The plugin adds a Maintenance Exceptions page under Settings. You can:

  • select specific WordPress pages,
  • enter an exact path, for example /contact/,
  • allow an entire URL branch using a wildcard, for example /pages/*.

The plugin uses an official Elementor filter and does not modify Elementor files.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance Exceptions.
  3. Select pages or enter URL rules.
  4. Save the settings.
sections.changelog:
0.4.0

  • Change the plugin directory, main file, and text domain to ds82-maintenance-exceptions-for-elementor.
  • Rename translation files and internal settings-page identifiers to match the new plugin slug.
  • Declare compatibility with WordPress 7.1.

0.3.0

  • Use unique plugin-specific setting identifiers to prevent conflicts with other plugins and themes.
  • Improve saving of full URL rules with trailing wildcards.
  • Fix URL exceptions being cleared during the first save after activation.

0.2.0

  • Rename the plugin to Denis82cz Maintenance Exceptions for Elementor.

0.1.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Keep selected WordPress pages accessible during Elementor maintenance mode.
  • Support exact URL rules and wildcard rules for entire URL branches.
  • Add a direct URL settings link to the plugin action row.
  • Include Czech, German, Russian, French, Polish, and Slovak translations.
  • Use a unique ds82 code prefix to prevent conflicts with other plugins.
  • Add a descriptive title for the WordPress.org plugin listing.
